meaning:
ἁρμόζω
(ἁρμός), [in LXX for אמן, etc. ;]
1. to fit, join.
2. of marriage, to betroth. Mid.,
(a) to join to oneself, marry, take to wife; (b) to give in marriage: 2Co.11:2 (for this there is no direct parallel. But see M, Pr., 160; MM, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
